test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

After reflecting on the matter regarding his boss's selfish attitude, Raju decided to __force himself to perform an unpleasant action in a difficult situation in order to resolve the matter__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "bite the bullet" means to force oneself to perform an unpleasant action in a difficult situation.
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• "Dodge the bullet" means to avoid a difficult or dangerous situation, which is not the case here.
 
• "Shoot the bullet" and "ignore the bullet" are not commonly used idioms and do not convey the intended meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After reflecting on the matter regarding his boss's selfish attitude, Raju decided to bite the bullet to resolve the matter."*
